title: Eculizumab Pharmacokinetics/Pharmacodynamics Study in Pediatric/Adolescent Paroxysmal Nocturnal Hemoglobinuria (PNH)
brief_summary: The primary objective of this study was to evaluate the pharmacokinetic (PK) and pharmacodynamic (PD) parameter estimates of eculizumab to confirm the dose regimens for pediatric and adolescent participants with PNH.
